info.title: Zaminnegar API
info.description:
Farmland management API. Geometry is GeoJSON in WGS 84 (EPSG:4326) with `[longitude, latitude]` ordering. Errors share one envelope (`ErrorResponseDto`).

**Authentication.** Call `POST /auth/login` with email and password to get a session token, then send it as `Authorization: Bearer <token>` on every other request (use the *Authorize* button here). A missing, invalid or expired token gives `401`; a valid token without the required permission on the project in question gives `403`. Permissions come from roles stored in the database and are granted either globally (global role) or per project (project membership).
